का . आ . 806 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. , जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , 
उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा बिहार राज्य के पटना जिले में रिंग रोड के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी .8.484 ( हिंदी 
भवन , पटना ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी

" दैनिक भास्कर " और " द हिन्दुस्तान टाइम्स " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 806 ( E ) .- Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of Ring Road on the 
stretch of land from Km 0 to Km 8.484 ( Hindi Bhawan , patna ) in the district of PATNA in the state of BIHAR 


3 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Dainik Bhaskar " and " The 
Hindustan Times ” both dated 8 July 2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


0.0364 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


0.0334 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


0.1042 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3539 ( अ ) तिथि 29/07/2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा हरियाणा राज्य के यमुनानगर जिले में जगाधरी 
पोंटा साहिब खंड राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या -73 A ( New NH - 907 ) के कि.मी. 0.000 से कि.मी. 52.794 ( यमुनानगर ) तक 
के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 02/08/2022 " 
को " द ट्रिब्यून ( अंग्रेज़ी ) " और " जगमार्ग ( हिन्दी ) " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 808 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways S.O. 3539 ( E ) dated 29/07/2022 published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of 


50 


[ PART II - SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

Jagadhari - Paonta Sahib Section of NH - 73A ( New NH - 907 ) on the stretch of land from Km 0.000 to Km 52.794 
( Yamunanagar ) in the district of YAMUNANAGAR in the state of HARYANA ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " The Tribune ( English ) " and 
" Jagmarg ( Hindi ) ” both dated 02/08/2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ;

है ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 816 ( E ) – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O.4114 ( E ) dated on 01 September 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , 
Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning , 
etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of Kalwakurthy- Kollapur section of NH - 167K in the stretch of 
land from Km . 46.130 to Km . 79.300 ( Revenue Divisional officer , Kollapur ) in the district of 

NAGARKURNOOL in the state of TELANGANA . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Namasthe Telangana " ( Telugu ) 
and “ The Hindu " ( English ) both dated 21 September 2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1170 ( अ ) दिनांक 16.03.2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के हनुमानगढ़ जिले में राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग -54 के कि.मी. 0.0 से कि.मी. 49/700 ( हनुमानगढ केंचिया सेक्शन ) तक के भूखण्ड के निर्माण , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन 
और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की 

थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 01 अप्रैल 
2022 " एवं " 02 अप्रैल 2022 " को क्रमशः " त्रिमुर्ति संदेश " और " दैनिक इबादत " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 

है ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 819 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 1170 ( E ) dated 16.03.2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub- section ( ii ) issued under sub- section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building , Maintenance , management and operation of National 
Highway- 54 on the stretch of land from Km . 0.0 to Km . 49.700 ( Hanumangarh- Kenchiya section ) in the District of 
Hanumangarh in the State of Rajasthan . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Trimurti Sandesh ” and “ Dainik 
Ibadat " on dated " 01 April 2022 " and " 02 April 2022 " respectively under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said 
Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ]

And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

अधिसूचना 


नई दिल्ली 22 फरवरी , 2023 

का.आ. 824 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1481 ( अ ) तारीख , 30 मार्च , 2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के मलेरकोटला जिले में नया 
प्रस्तावित ( 205 एजी ) राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग सरहिंद फतेहगढ़ साहिब - सहेना बरनाला के कि.मी. 33.8 से कि . मी . 62.255 तक 
के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 06.04.2022 " 
को " द टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया ( इंग्लिश ) " और " जगबानी ( पंजाबी ) " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 824 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O . 1481 ( E ) Dated 30th March , 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of Newly Proposed ( NH - 205AG ) on the stretch of land ( Sarhind Fatehgarh Sahib - Sehna Barnala ) from 
Km . 33.8 to Km . 62.255 in the district of MALERKOTLA in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " The Times of India ( English ) " and 
" Jagbani ( Punjabi ) " both dated 06.04.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act 


88 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया 
गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् उप - मण्डल मजिस्ट्रेट , पठानकोट को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की 
जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी 
विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के 
पश्चात् , यदि कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या 
अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा । 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd February, 2023 


S.O. 842(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act,l956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH75 
in the stretch of land from Km 84.92 to Km230.06 (HIG-64, DTDC Currier office Building, First Floor KHB 
Colony, Channapatana Opposite KSRCTC New Bus Stand Hassan) in the district of HASSAN in the state of 
KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Assistance Commissioner in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 852 ( E ) . In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of Ring Road in 
the stretch of land from Km 23.5 to Km 25.5 ( District Revenue Officer , KAPURTHALA ) , Ring Road in the stretch of 
land from Km 26.6 to Km29.5 ( District Revenue Officer , KAPURTHALA ) in the district of KAPURTHALA in the 
state of PUNJAB , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , District Revenue Officer , 
Kapurthala ( Km 26.6 to Km29.5 Jalandhar Ring Road ) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard , either in person or by a legal practitioner , 
and may , after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority 
thinks necessary , by order , either allow or disallow the objections .

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 825 ( E ) . 

Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 3360 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under 
sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , 
the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of Greenfield Highway 
on the stretch of land from Km . 110.5 to Km . 149.9 in the district of AURANGABAD in the state of BIHAR ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Hindustan ” and “ Hindustan 
Times " both dated 02.08.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 817 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways being S.O. 4973 ( E ) dated 20/10/22 , published in Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part - II , Section 3 , Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under Sub - section ( i ) of section 3A of the National Highways Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule 
annexed to the said notification for " Improvement / Upgradation of NH - 60 to 4 lane from existing K.M 306.00 
( Pandabeswar ) to K.M 321.00 ( Dubrajpur ) in the district of Birbhum , West Bengal " 


142 


[ PART II - SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in the " BARTAMAN ” and in " THE 
TELEGRAPH " both dated 11/11/2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been heard , considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority . 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government . 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of the section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 853 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात् 
उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
जाने के पश्चात् कि उड़ीसा राज्य के खोर्धा जिले में Greenfield Highway के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 11.1 ( एट् - तंगी , डिस्ट 
खोर्दा ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेन्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 - लेन / 4 लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् तहसीलदार तंगी को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें 
उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर 
द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि कोई 
हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा ।

अंतिम होगा ।

S.O. 853 ( E ) .— In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways

the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of Greenfield 
Highway in the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km11.1 ( At - Tangi , Dist - Khordha ) in the district of KHORDHA in the 
state of ODISHA , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act .

enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , either allow or disallow the objections .

का.आ. 839 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात् 
उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान हो 
जाने के पश्चात् कि मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के ग्वालियर जिले में नवीन प्रस्तावित पश्चिम बायपास के कि.मी. 21.150 से कि.मी. 
26.700 ( कार्यालय अनुविभागीय अधिकारी ( राजस्व ) , घाटीगांव ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर 
सहित 2 लेन / 4 - लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है 
जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् अनुविभागीय अधिकारी को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और 
उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा । 


2 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा । 


इस अधिसूचना के अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के रेखांक और अन्य ब्यौरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त कार्यालय में 
उपलब्ध हैं और उनका हितबद्ध व्यक्तियों द्वारा निरीक्षण किया जा सकता है ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 839 ( E ) .– In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of Connecting of 
Newly Proposed western bypass of Gwalior in the stretch of land from Km 21.150 to Km.26.700 ( office of the Sub 
Divisional Officer , Ghatigaon ) in the district of GWALIOR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH , hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land . 


6 


[ PART II SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , sub - divisional officer in writing 
and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being 
heard , either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may , after hearing all such objections and after making such 
further enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , either allow or disallow the objections . 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final . 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority .

S.O. 868(E).— Whereas, the use of Aadhaar as identity document for delivery of services or benefits or 
subsidies simplifies the Government delivery processes, brings in transparency and efficiency, and enables 
beneficiaries to get their entitlements directly to them in a convenient and seamless manner and Aadhaar obviates the 
need for producing multiple documents to prove one’s identity; 


And, whereas, the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying (hereinafter referred to as the 
Ministry) in the Government of India is administering the scheme of Breed Multiplication Farm, Nationwide Artificial 
Insemination Programme and Accelerated Breed Improvement Programme using Sex Sorted Semen and through In 
Vitro Fertilization — components under the Rashtriya Gokul Mission (herein referred to as the Scheme) which is 
implemented by the State Governments and Union Territory Administrations through the State Implementing 
Agencies and National Dairy Development Board (herein after referred to as the Implementing Agency as per details 
given as Annexure I ) across the country; 


And whereas, under the scheme, subsidy and services are reimbursed (herein referred to as the benefits) as 
per details at Annexure I], inter-alia, to the farmers, and individual entrepreneurs or Self Help Group (SHG) or 
Farmers Cooperative Organisation (FCO) or Farmers Producers Organizations (FPOs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLG) 
and section 8 companies (hereinafter referred to as the beneficiaries), towards central assistance for credit-cum- 
subsidy linked activities for the different sub components as per the extant Scheme guidelines; 


And whereas, the aforesaid Scheme involves recurring expenditure incurred from the Consolidated Fund of 
India; 


Now, therefore, in pursuance of the provisions of section 7 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial 
and other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 20I6 (8 of 206) (herein after referred to the said Act), the Central 
Government hereby requires the following namely:— 


l. () Every eligible beneficiaries desirous of availing the benefits under the Scheme is hereby required to furnish 
proof of possession of Aadhaar number or undergo Aadhaar authentication. 


(2) Every eligible beneficiary desirous of availing the benefits under the Scheme, who does not possess the 
Aadhaar number or, has not yet enrolled for Aadhaar, shall have to apply for Aadhaar enrolment provided he or she is 
entitled to obtain Aadhaar as per the provisions of section 3 of the said Act and such persons may visit any Aadhaar 
enrolment centre [list available at Unique Identification Authority of India website www.uidai.gov.in] for Aadhaar 
enrolment. 


(3) As per regulation !2 of Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) Regulations, 206, the concerned Department, 
which is responsible for implementation of the Scheme in the State Government or Union territory Administration or 
the Ministry, is required to offer Aadhaar enrolment facilities for the beneficiaries who are not yet enrolled for 
Aadhaar and in case there is no Aadhaar enrolment centre located in the respective Block or Taluka or Tehsil, the said 
concerned Department shall provide enrolment facilities at convenient locations in coordination with the existing 
registrars of expand or by becoming expand registrars itself: 


Provided that till the time Aadhaar is assigned to the individual, benefits under the Scheme shall be given to 
such individuals, subject to the production of the following documents, namely:— 


(a) if beneficiary has enrolled, his Aadhaar Enrolment Identification slip or biometric update identification 
slip; and 


(b) any one of the following identify documents of the beneficiary namely:- () Bank Passbook or Post 
office Passbook with photo; or (ii) Voter Identification Card; or (iii) Permanent Account Number 
(PAN) Card; or (iv) Passport; or (v) Driving licence issued by Licencing Authority under the Motor 
Vehicles Act, 988 (59 of 988); or (vi) Ration Card; or (vii) expand Job Card; or (viii) Kisan Photo 
Passbook; or (ix) Certificate of identity having photo of such person issued by a Gazetted Officer or a 
Tehsildar on an official letter head; or (x) Any other document as specified by the Ministry: 


Provided further that the above documents shall be checked by an officer designated by the Ministry for that 
purpose. 


2. In order to provide convenient and hassle free benefits to the beneficiaries under the Scheme, the Department, 
which is responsible for implementation of the Scheme in the State Government or Union territory Administration 
through the implementing Agency, shall make all the required arrangements to ensure wide publicity through media 
is given to the beneficiaries to make them aware of the requirement of Aadhaar under the Scheme.

का.आ. 848 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि जम्मू और कश्मीर केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के पुंछ जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या 144 ए के 
कि.मी 162 + 800 से 198 + 250 कि.मी. तक अखनूर से पूँछ रोड का निर्माण ( चैडीकरण / दो लेन का बनाने आदि ) , 
अनुरक्षण , प्रबंध और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है , जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया 
गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है ; 


कोई व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोत्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर आक्षेप 
कर सकेगा : 


ऐसा प्रत्येक आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात् डिप्टी कमिश्नर पुँछ , जिला- पुँछ को लिखित रूप में किया जाएगा और

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 22nd February , 2023 

S.O. 848 ( E ) .— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereafter referred to as the said act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / 2 - Laning with paved shoulder ) , maintenance , management and operation of the National Highway 
No. 144A in the stretch of land from Km 162 + 800 to 198 + 250 Km Akhnoor to Poonch Road in the District - Poonch 
in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land ; 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3 C of the said act ; 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , the Deputy Commissioner 
Poonch , District Poonch , in writing and shall set out the grounds there of and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard , either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry , if any , as the competent authority thinks necessary , by order , either 
allow or disallow the objections . 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3 C of the said act shall be final . 
The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the 
interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority .
